name: Great Microwave Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Great Microwave Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of integrated circuit chips and microsystems in China. The company offers radio frequency front-end and transceiver chips; high-speed, high-precision ADC/DAC chips; power management chips; and microsystems and modules. It also provides technical services. The company's products and technologies are used in various industries, such as data links, electronic countermeasures, wireless communication terminals, next-generation radios, phased array communications, phased array radars, and power supply and distribution for electronic systems.
